what: One document's rows on two copies built from two manifests: A under max_parties=2, B under max_parties=3 (manifest.json gives each copy's signed-view digest). Ada and Bo are seated on both; Ada's move is on A only and Bo's on B only. A merge refuses, whole, a sibling whose signed-view digest differs from its own (SIGNED_VIEW_MISMATCH): nothing is taken in either direction (R16). Before, the merge took everything and the two copies could seat differently for the same rows (review 9, A04).
